title: Uniform Gamma from tracial-ultrapower real rank zero
exact_target: Let A be simple separable unital infinite-dimensional nuclear stably finite with nonempty tracial-state space, and let B be its uniform tracial completion. For any free ultrafilter $\omega $, does real rank zero of the designated uniform tracial ultrapower $B^\omega $ in its quotient C*-norm imply uniform property Gamma for A?
